answer: Each identity locks 500 POA for thirty epochs, and every funding cluster is one vertex in a graph the seed redraws each six-hour round. Two percent of vertices get a rebuild audit; any watcher may claim by escrowing 25 POA, and if a panel confirms three kin-linked accounts the bond is seized, sixty percent to the watcher, forty burned. A thousand clones put 500,000 POA behind one 25 POA claim, so the farm must outbid every watcher. False claims lose the escrow. An opal shifts colour at each angle; a village that pays the neighbour who finds termites needs no relic of an old survey.
